task: Add an optional service_fee to supermarket checkout and receipts. Public APIs must support Teller.checks_out_articles_from(cart, service_fee=0) and Receipt(service_fee=0). Existing calls without the argument must keep working. Add the fee exactly once after existing item prices and discounts. Accept finite int/float values greater than or equal to zero; reject negative values, NaN, infinity, strings, None and bool with a clear ValueError. Preserve existing quantities, prices and discounts. Find the relevant modules yourself with the repository tools, implement the feature across the interacting modules, run feature, regression_core, regression_pricing and lint, and fix any failed checks before finishing.
